IsAllowed.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: pool eligibility is modelled now. `Relic.is_allowed(run)` exists on the sim's base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:253, default True) and this relic overrides it with `is_before_act3_treasure_chest(run)` (sts2_rl/relics/amethyst_aubergine.py:33), the `TotalFloor < 41` predicate of RelicModel.IsBeforeAct3TreasureChest (RelicModel.cs:452-456). RunState._drop_disallowed_from_grab_bag (sts2_rl/run.py:1080) applies it before EVERY pull and REMOVES the rejects from the bag -- pull_relic_from_front (run.py:970), pull_relic_from_back (run.py:1023) and the Shop-rarity bag (run.py:1060) are the only three pull paths -- mirroring RelicGrabBag.RemoveDisallowedRelicsFromDeques (RelicGrabBag.cs:218-270), and `Relic.is_allowed_at_neow` now DELEGATES to is_allowed (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:266-277 = RelicModel.cs:443-446) so the Neow pools (sts2_rl/events/neow.py:72) cannot read a stale flag. Verified by execution against today's code: every one of the 17 cluster members returns is_allowed False at total_floor 60 and True at floor 0. WAS: the sim's Relic base declared no is_allowed member at all and populate_relic_grab_bags shuffled the pool once at run init with no per-pull filter, so the relic stayed pullable for the whole run and a late pull also shifted every subsequent pull.
